column15: {=ARM_KR_013_1_U}A white raven flies from the Citadel of Oldtown to every castle in the realm, and the maesters read the message aloud in the halls: the Conclave has met and declared that the long summer is over. Autumn has come to Westeros.
column16: {=ARM_KR_013_1_L}Wise lords fill their granaries while the harvests still come in. The smallfolk hope for a mild autumn and a short winter, but no maester will promise either, and the old songs say long summers bring long winters.

column15: {=ARM_KR_013_2_U}The white ravens of the Citadel fly again, and this time they carry the message every lord has dreaded: winter has come. The Conclave has declared it, and the bells of the septs ring it out from Oldtown to the Wall.
column16: {=ARM_KR_013_2_L}Fields give less and the North suffers most. Armies eat more on the march, horses need fodder instead of grass, and every lord would do well to count how many days his granaries can still feed his people.

column15: {=ARM_KR_013_3_U}At last the white ravens bring the news the realm has waited for: the Conclave of the Citadel declares that winter is over and spring has come. In the villages the shutters are thrown open and the first ploughs bite into the thawing earth.
column16: {=ARM_KR_013_3_L}The roads turn to mud and the rivers swell with snowmelt, but the worst is over. Granaries can be filled again, and the lords who lived through the cold can think about their fields instead of their stores.

column1: # 014 Wielki Zwiad - Piesc (castle_S6) nalezy w ROT do Tormunda: zbiorka (muster) przy Czarnym Zamku, dowoz zboza do Czarnego Zamku, tekst bez twierdzenia, ze Straz trzyma Piesc (wariant a, gdy trzyma).

column15: {=ARM_KR_014_1_U}When word of Lord Eddard's death reaches the Wall, Jon Snow saddles his horse in the night and rides south to join his brother Robb. Before dawn his friends from the Watch catch him on the kingsroad, remind him of his vows and bring him back.
column16: {=ARM_KR_014_1_L}The Old Bear knew all along and says only that Jon's place is on the Wall. Soon after he announces that he will lead three hundred brothers beyond it, to find Benjen Stark and learn what stirs in the haunted forest.
column18: {=ARM_KR_014_1_Q}You see Jon Snow lead his horse out of the stables after dark. What do you do?

column15: {=ARM_KR_014_2_U}The Lord Commander leads three hundred black brothers north through the haunted forest. They find empty wildling villages and a few frozen dead, then shelter at Craster's Keep, where a wildling lives with wives who are also his daughters, and his sons vanish into the cold.
column16: {=ARM_KR_014_2_L}From there Mormont marches on toward the Fist of the First Men, an old ring fort on a hill, to wait for his scouts and for word of Mance Rayder, who is said to be gathering all the free folk in the mountains.

column15: {=ARM_KR_014_2a_U}The Lord Commander leads three hundred black brothers north through the haunted forest. They find empty wildling villages and a few frozen dead, then shelter at Craster's Keep, where a wildling lives with wives who are also his daughters, and his sons vanish into the cold.
column16: {=ARM_KR_014_2a_L}From there Mormont makes camp on the Fist of the First Men, an old ring fort on a hill, to wait for his scouts and for word of Mance Rayder, who is said to be gathering all the free folk in the mountains.

column1: # 015 Szczury w spizarni - oblezona twierdza 3 doby bez jedzenia, raz na oblezenie, takze w prologu; obronca w srodku wybiera (okno 1), oblegajacy obok (okno 2), reszta wiesc. Zjedzenie koni bez akcji w slowniku = opcja bierna.

column15: {=ARM_KR_015_1_U}In besieged {CEL} the larders are empty. The garrison has eaten its stores down to the last sack, and now the cooks serve rats, boiled leather and whatever can be caught on the walls. Children cry at night and the old are the first to die.
column16: {=ARM_KR_015_1_L}The captains say the walls can hold, but the bellies cannot. Someone must decide whether the horses go to the pot or the smallfolk go out of the gates, before hunger opens the castle better than any ram.
column18: {=ARM_KR_015_1_Q}{CEL} is starving. What do you order?

column15: {=ARM_KR_015_2_U}At dawn the postern of {CEL} opens and a thin line of women, children and old men walks out toward the siege lines, carrying bundles and nothing else. The garrison has pushed them out to save its food, and now they stand between the walls and your camp.
column16: {=ARM_KR_015_2_L}Let them pass and the castle holds out longer, with fewer mouths to feed. Turn them back and they will starve beside the gate and the defenders will break sooner, but no one will sing of it kindly.
column18: {=ARM_KR_015_2_Q}Starving smallfolk stand before your lines. What do you do?

column1: # 016 Szepczacy Las - w ROT Jaime trafia do niewoli Starkow juz na starcie wojny (m01, w E5 p10 Riverrun): okna opowiadaja te zmiane po fakcie; wariant a = Jaime nie jest jencem.

column15: {=ARM_KR_016_1_U}Now that the river lords have taken up arms, the tale of the first days of the war is told again in every hall. Jaime Lannister had broken the river lords at the Golden Tooth, scattered their host before Riverrun and penned the castle in with three great camps.
column16: {=ARM_KR_016_1_L}He was sure no relief could reach him. But a young king from the North was already riding south through the forest by night, and the Kingslayer was about to learn what it meant to sleep with a wolf at his back.

column15: {=ARM_KR_016_1a_U}The river lords have taken up arms, and the lions answer at once. Jaime Lannister leads the host of the west into the Riverlands, burning as he comes, and swears to have the gates of Riverrun open before the leaves turn.
column16: {=ARM_KR_016_1a_L}Every lord of the Trident knows that the Kingslayer has never lost a fight he chose. The river lords look north and wait for the young wolf to come to their aid.

column15: {=ARM_KR_016_2_U}On a moonless night Robb Stark led his horsemen through the narrow valley of the Whispering Wood, where the trees hid them until the last moment. Jaime Lannister rode out to meet what he took for a raid, and found the whole northern host closing around him.
column16: {=ARM_KR_016_2_L}The Kingslayer cut his way almost to Robb himself before he was dragged from his horse. Next day the wolves broke the camps around Riverrun, and Lord Tywin's eldest son was led away in chains.

column15: {=ARM_KR_016_2a_U}On a moonless night Robb Stark led his horsemen through the narrow valley of the Whispering Wood and fell on the Lannister camps around Riverrun. The siege broke in a single night, and the river lords came out of their castle cheering.
column16: {=ARM_KR_016_2a_L}But the Kingslayer cut his way out of the trap with a handful of knights and rode back to his father. The war that might have ended that night goes on.

column1: # 017 Bractwo bez Choragwi - tylko gdy gracz jest w Dorzeczu; Beric nie jest bohaterem ROT_heroes (ROTuniqueleader) - brak termu, ze zyje; banda Berica z E5 bez nowej definicji, b017 = tabor Lannisterow.

column15: {=ARM_KR_017_1_U}In a burned village you come upon ragged men with a purple lightning bolt sewn on their cloaks. They are what remains of the riders Lord Eddard sent to bring the Mountain to justice, and they say their leader, Lord Beric Dondarrion, has fallen more than once and always risen again.
column16: {=ARM_KR_017_1_L}Now they fight for no king, only for the smallfolk the Lannister raiders are burning out of their homes. Their red priest, Thoros of Myr, asks you plainly whether you will help them or ride on.
column18: {=ARM_KR_017_1_Q}The outlaws wait for your answer. What will you do?

column15: {=ARM_KR_017_2_U}Hooded outlaws stop you on a forest road and lead you blindfolded to a cave beneath a hill, where roots hang from the roof and a great fire burns. Lord Beric Dondarrion sits beside it, one eye gone, his body scarred by deaths he should not have survived.
column16: {=ARM_KR_017_2_L}Thoros of Myr pours you a cup, and the outlaws tell of their war: villages saved, raiders hanged, and a red god who keeps sending their lord back from the dark. You part from them as friends.

column15: {=ARM_KR_017_2a_U}Hooded outlaws stop you on a forest road and lead you blindfolded to a cave beneath a hill, where roots hang from the roof and a great fire burns. Lord Beric Dondarrion sits beside it, one eye gone, his body scarred by deaths he should not have survived.
column16: {=ARM_KR_017_2a_L}But the outlaws have long memories, and they know who sold them to the lions. They take a tenth of your purse as the price of your life and send you back to the road with a warning not to return.

column1: # 018 Dolina zamyka bramy - wojny ROT bez zmian (tylko relacje); wariant a = Dolina ma innego wladce niz Lysa.

column15: {=ARM_KR_018_1_U}Lady Lysa Arryn will send no knights to her sister's war. Shut away in the Eyrie with her sickly son, she sees enemies in every shadow and wants only to keep the Bloody Gate closed and the boy safe. Catelyn's letters go unanswered.
column16: {=ARM_KR_018_1_L}From King's Landing comes a sweeter offer: the crown will name little Robert Arryn Warden of the East if the Vale stays out of the war, and Petyr Baelish whispers promises of his own. The knights of the Vale stay home.
column18: {=ARM_KR_018_1_Q}The lords of the Vale argue in the hall. What do you counsel?

column15: {=ARM_KR_018_1a_U}{RULER} will send no knights to the war of the Starks. The Eyrie is high and the Bloody Gate is strong, and the lords of the Vale see no reason to bleed for the North or the Trident while their own mountains are safe.
column16: {=ARM_KR_018_1a_L}From King's Landing comes a sweeter offer of honours if the Vale keeps out of the fighting, and the knights of the Vale stay at home, polishing armour they may never wear in war.
column18: {=ARM_KR_018_1a_Q}The lords of the Vale argue in the hall. What do you counsel?

column1: # 019 Myrcella odplywa - okno za stanem paktu z Dorne (cw:dorne, straznik Prologue.Crown); Myrcella zostaje w rodzie i na mapie (bez akcji przeniesienia); jedzenie w spichrzach bez akcji (ware od K6).

column15: {=ARM_KR_019_1_U}To bind Dorne to the crown, Princess Myrcella is promised to Prince Trystane Martell and sails for Sunspear with a knight of the Kingsguard at her side. The whole court rides down to the docks to see her off, then back through streets full of hungry people.
column16: {=ARM_KR_019_1_L}A mob breaks through the gold cloaks. The High Septon is torn to pieces, a knight is dragged from his horse, and Sansa Stark would have been next if the Hound had not cut his way to her and carried her to safety.

column15: {=ARM_KR_019_1a_U}To bind Dorne to the crown, Princess Myrcella is promised to Prince Trystane Martell and sails for Sunspear with a knight of the Kingsguard at her side. The whole court rides down to the docks to see her off, then back through streets full of hungry people.
column16: {=ARM_KR_019_1a_L}A mob breaks through the gold cloaks. The High Septon is torn to pieces and a knight is dragged from his horse, and the royal party reaches the Red Keep only because the Hound cuts a path through the crowd.

column1: # 020 Lady Hornwood - w ROT Halys i Daryn Hornwood zyja (w ksiazce polegli): wiersz glowny = porwanie bez slubu, wariant a = wdowa (kanon). Ramsay nie prowadzi bandy i nie ginie (chroniony do BastardsEvent).

column15: {=ARM_KR_020_1_U}While Lord Halys Hornwood is away with the host, riders under a flayed-man banner fall on his lands. Their leader is Ramsay Snow, the bastard son of Roose Bolton, and he carries Lady Donella Hornwood off to the Dreadfort like a sack of grain.
column16: {=ARM_KR_020_1_L}They say he locked her in a tower and gave her nothing to eat until she starved. His men stay in the woods around Hornwood, burning the villages one by one.

column15: {=ARM_KR_020_1a_U}Lord Hornwood has died in the war, and his widow sits alone in her castle. Ramsay Snow, the bastard son of Roose Bolton, takes her by force, has a septon wed them before his men and claims all the Hornwood lands as her husband.
column16: {=ARM_KR_020_1a_L}Then he locks Lady Donella in a tower and gives her nothing to eat until she starves. His men stay in the woods around Hornwood, burning the villages of anyone who speaks against him.

column15: {=ARM_KR_020_2_U}Old Ser Rodrik Cassel, castellan of Winterfell, rides out with what men are left to him and catches the Bastard's riders in the act. A man in Ramsay's cloak and rings flees and is shot down, and across the North men cheer that the Bastard of the Dreadfort is dead.
column16: {=ARM_KR_020_2_L}But the dead man was only a servant called Reek. Ramsay Snow had changed clothes with him before the fight and slipped away in rags, and his boys still burn the villages around Hornwood.

column1: # 021 Renly - slubu w grze nie ma (ROT kasuje rod Renly po jego smierci), tylko relacje; turniej w oknie 2 w najblizszym miescie Reach (Tumbleton, town_ES7 - Gorzki Most to zamek).

column15: {=ARM_KR_021_1_U}At Highgarden Renly Baratheon weds Margaery Tyrell, and with the roses of the Reach behind him he crowns himself king of the Seven Kingdoms. Lord Mace Tyrell beams at the high table, already seeing his daughter as queen and his grandson on the Iron Throne.
column16: {=ARM_KR_021_1_L}Renly marches north at the head of the greatest host seen in a generation, more a summer fair than an army, with pavilions and tourneys at every halt. He is in no hurry. The throne, he says, will wait for him.

column15: {=ARM_KR_021_2_U}At Bitterbridge Renly holds a great tourney for his new queen. To the crowd's astonishment the champion is a huge knight in blue armour who unhorses the Knight of Flowers himself, then lifts the helm to reveal Brienne of Tarth, the plain daughter of Lord Selwyn.
column16: {=ARM_KR_021_2_L}As her prize she asks a place in Renly's new Rainbow Guard, and he grants it. An envoy from the North watches from the stands. Downriver at Tumbleton new lists are raised, and any knight may ride.

column15: {=ARM_KR_021_2a_U}At Bitterbridge Renly holds a great tourney for his new queen. Ser Loras Tyrell, the Knight of Flowers, unhorses every challenger in a shower of petals, and Renly names him first of his new Rainbow Guard, seven knights for the seven gods.
column16: {=ARM_KR_021_2a_L}An envoy from the North watches from the stands and wonders whether this king will ever fight a battle. Downriver at Tumbleton new lists are raised, and any knight may ride.

column1: # 022 Wolowy Brod - miekki cel zbiorki armii Polnocy pod Ashemark (muster, bez wymuszania); Turnia pominieta (wyzwalacz m26 Jeyne Westerling own:castle_EN6:battania).

column15: {=ARM_KR_022_1_U}Instead of marching on King's Landing, Robb Stark turns west into the lands of the Lannisters. At Oxcross he falls by night on the new host Ser Stafford Lannister is raising, and the green levies of the west are cut down before they can form a line.
column16: {=ARM_KR_022_1_L}After that the young wolf goes from castle to castle along the hills, burning the fields and driving off the herds, so that Lord Tywin must choose between his capital and his own lands. Ashemark is said to be next.

column15: {=ARM_KR_023_1_U}With the swords of the North far to the south, the ironborn strike. Victarion Greyjoy sails the Iron Fleet toward Moat Cailin, Yara Greyjoy takes Deepwood Motte in a night attack, and Theon burns the fishing villages of the Stony Shore.
column16: {=ARM_KR_023_1_L}All along the western coast the longships come ashore and the smallfolk flee inland with what they can carry. Lords who left only boys and old men in their castles now wonder whether they will have castles to come home to.

column15: {=ARM_KR_024_1_U}At dawn black sails come out of the mist and longships run up onto the shingle near {CEL}. Ironborn with axes pour onto the beach, thatched roofs begin to burn, and the smallfolk run inland with their children and whatever they can carry.
column16: {=ARM_KR_024_1_L}The reavers will not stay long. They take what they can load, grain and silver and captives, and row away before the lords can come. Whoever rides now might still catch them at their boats.
column18: {=ARM_KR_024_1_Q}Ironborn are burning the coast near {CEL}. What do you do?
